summary: Tested all 15 features for dynamic header transition on Pharmacy page and Mango category page redesign. All tests PASSED. Dynamic header uses IntersectionObserver to detect light zone and transitions from dark (#0a0b14) to cream (#FFF8F0) with 0.5s CSS transition. Logo gets darkened (brightness 0.15), wallet icon changes to amber-600, user icon changes to dark, tab gradients fade to cream. Mango category pages have premium hero banners with category-specific gradients (teal for full-body, pink for womens-health, amber for diabetes-care), decorative circles, wave SVG, 3D green add buttons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic header transition verified working on Pharmacy page. IntersectionObserver on lightZoneRef (data-testid=pharmacy-light-zone) with rootMargin '-60px 0px 0px 0px' triggers headerLightMode state. ServiceHeader accepts lightMode prop (default false) and applies: cream background (#FFF8F0), logo brightness(0.15), wallet amber-600 (#B45309), user dark (#57534e), tab gradients fade to cream. Mango category pages use CATEGORY_CONFIG for gradient colors: full-body=teal, womens-health=pink, diabetes-care=amber. All have wave SVG, decorative circles, 3D green buttons with box-shadow.
